By definition, an exothermic reaction releases heat to the surroundings, causing a temperature rise (q_system < 0, q_surroundings > 0). The scenario describes a temperature drop (cold produced), which indicates an endothermic reaction (q_system > 0, q_surroundings < 0). suggested_fix.fix_text: When a chemical reaction produces a drop in temperature (surroundings get colder), the surroundings have lost heat, so q_surroundings < 0. Since energy is conserved (q_system + q_surroundings = 0), q_system must be > 0. A reaction where the system absorbs heat from the surroundings (causing them to cool down) is endothermic. Therefore, the answer is B) endothermic.
